facts.value: Are you interested in Science? Are you concerned about the quality of our environment? Would you like a career helping to make improvements to our environment for the benefit of this and future generations? Do you want to understand more about the global and national challenges of climate change and sustainability? Then perhaps you should study Environmental Science at UL.
This course will help you understand more about global challenges around climate change and sustainability in preparation for a career to tackle these issues.
The programme includes 8 months’ work experience.
The courses are focused on developing industry-ready graduates.
